newsitem.title: USA: Industrial Scientific sets first dividend.
newsitem.headline: Industrial Scientific sets first dividend.

text.p: Industrial Scientific Corp said on Wednesday that its directors had delcared a first-time dividend of $0.04 a share, the company's first as a public corporation.
The dividend will be payable on July 1 to stockholders of record as of June 23, the company said.

"The Board of Directors authorized the dividend because of the continuing strong performance of the company during the first quarter of fiscal year 1997," said company president Kent McElhattan, noting that sales increased 17 percent to a record of $10.9,952,000, during the first quarter ended May 2, 1997.
Industrial Scientific Corp, which became a public company in June 1993, manufactures gas monitoring instruments and other technical products.
